decisions.reason: The clarified bushing location does not change the existing POS 4 piston/rod-end arrangement.
The same-message shaft geometry Event already records the required bushing space, while the bushing-to-shaft relationship is owned by the source Requirement and should not be duplicated.
Locating the bushing inside the main shaft does not alter the established premachine-weld-final-machine fabrication sequence.
The bushing configuration does not change the assembly-based drawing numbering rule.
The bushing remains a bushing and its CuSn12 material specification is unaffected by its clarified installation location and fit.
The clarification informs model content but does not change the existing requirement to deliver a 3D assembly model; implementation status must not be propagated.
The bushing location and clearance do not modify the required ČSN/EN standards or template policy.
The mechanical clarification does not change the requested IPT or STEP delivery formats.

The source establishes the bushing design relationship and clearance selection, but does not independently change the general annotation requirement; duplicating those design attributes here is unnecessary.
The clarified design must be reflected in the drawings, but it does not change the requirement to provide the drawing set and must not be propagated as implementation status.
